stories.title: S. Korea reaches semis in women's volleyball at Asian Games after win over Kazakhstan

en.title: S. Korea reaches semis in women's volleyball at Asian Games after win over Kazakhstan
en.summary: South Korea advanced to the women's volleyball semifinals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Kazakhstan 3-0 in the quarterfinals. The team will face Japan in the next round.

stories.title: S. Korean Men's Basketball Team Wins Gold at Asian Games

en.title: S. Korean Men's Basketball Team Wins Gold at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korea's men's basketball team won the gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Japan 67-57 in the final, securing their first gold in the sport at the Asian Games.

en.summary: South Korea successfully defended its title in the men's team modern pentathlon at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, with athletes Jun Woong-tae, Lee Jong-hyeon, and Seo Chang-wan earning gold.

en.summary: South Korean pentathlete Seong Seung-min secured the country's first gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by winning the women's individual modern pentathlon event with 1,492 points.
